items.name: Incendiary Grenade (Commercial)
items.description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 1d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:5]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.

generalAbilities.name: Networked Nodocite
generalAbilities.description: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Block Path
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the nodocite's reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The nodocite sentry makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the target's movement is additionally disrupted.

offensiveAbilities.name: Area Fire
offensiveAbilities.description:
Incendiary Grenade (5ft Type:burst, range 70 feet)

Damage 1d8 Fire Damage (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw)

offensiveAbilities.name: Push
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Push in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Shove the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty. If Push lists a distance, change the distance the creature is pushed on a success to that distance.
